title: E4M3/E5M2 probing ensemble calibration and shadow-reconciliation for FP8 enablement on Hopper
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Safely enable FP8 quantization profiles (E4M3 and E5M2) for a subset of production Hopper model variants using a probabilistic probing ensemble, shadow reconciliation between FP8/FP16 traces, and per-op sensitivity clamps. This ticket implements: 1) a lightweight probing sampler to schedule short shadow requests that exercise long-tail sequence lengths and micro-batching corners, 2) an ensemble of calibration strategies (per-layer min-max, per-channel scale, and activation-clamp sketches) that run in parallel in the calibration pipeline, and 3) a reconciliation pass that computes divergence metrics and produces automated rollback suggestions. Deliverables: calibration harness changes, telemetry gating, golden-suite validation, and canary rollout playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness can run ensemble strategies in <30% additional GPU time vs baseline and emit per-op histograms
Shadow reconciliation produces divergence metrics (KL, token-error-rate delta, and top-k mismatch) and marks profiles: PASS / WARN / FAIL
Canary can route 1% of traffic to FP8 profiles for 48h with telemetry gating and automatic fallback to FP16 if thresholds exceeded
Regression tests (golden-suite) show <=0.6% avg token-level quality delta for production prompts used in our benchmarks
tasks: Add probing sampler to runtime request router (configurable rate & stratification)
Implement parallel ensemble runners in calibration service with timeout guarantees
Add per-op histogram and drift counters to telemetry schema
Create reconciliation job that computes KL / SER / top-k disagreement
telemetry_checks: Per-profile KL < 0.05 over golden-seed set -> PASS
Top-1 disagreement < 0.5% on small prompt corpus -> PASS
Latency p95 increase < 12ms on canary path -> PASS
Error-rate spike detection: any uncaught decode errors -> FAIL and immediate rollback
rollout_plan: 1) Internal shadow run for 48h over synthetic/real traffic; 2) Canary 0.5% traffic to FP8 ensemble for 24h with aggressive telemetry checks; 3) Expand to 2% for 72h if PASS; 4) Gradual ramp to 10% with per-region gating. Each stage has automatic fallback script and a human-reviewed rollback ticket if WARN persists after 24h.
risk_and_mitigation: DRIFT: model activation distribution drift — mitigate via adaptive clamps and daily recalibration job
LATENCY: extra probe overhead — mitigate by sampling budget and batching probes into low-priority shards
ACCURACY: edge-case degradation — mitigate with golden-suite smoke and per-customer safety flags to opt-out
